title: Hardware-Aligned Sparse Attention Selection (128K-1M Context): DeepSeek NSA vs. Moonshot MoBA vs. Dense FlashAttention-3

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Dense Full Attention (FlashAttention-3 FP16/BF16, 100% O(S^2) Tokens)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Short-to-medium context (<32K tokens) where O(S^2) attention is <30% of FLOPs

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Static Sliding Window + Attention Sinks (StreamingLLM 4 Sinks + 4K Window)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Infinite streaming chat without middle-document retrieval requirements

tiers.tier: Tier 3: MoBA (Mixture of Block Attention, Parameter-Free Top-K Block Routing + FlashVarlen)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Drop-in sparse adaptation of existing dense models via continued pre-training

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): NSA (Native Sparse Attention: Coarse Compression + GQA-Aligned Block Selection + Sliding Window)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Native 128K-1M pre-training & serving achieving 9.0x Prefill and 4.2x Decode speedup
